crossRefs.note: Every one had four faces, and every one four wings. The likeness of the hands of a man was under their wings.
They had the hands of a man under their wings on their four sides. The four of them had their faces and their wings…

translations.web: The form of a man’s hand appeared here in the cherubim under their wings.
translations.bsb: (The cherubim appeared to have the form of human hands under their wings.)
translations.kjv: And there appeared in the cherubims the form of a man's hand under their wings.
translations.asv: And there appeared in the cherubim the form of a man's hand under their wings.
